title: Senné: História (e-obce.sk, after Vlastivedný slovník obcí na Slovensku, vol. 3)
reliability: Digest of the standard Slovak gazetteer of 1977-78. Good for names, dates and counts; no footnotes.

title: Senné: Základné údaje (slovensko.sk, central public-administration portal)
reliability: Official portal, short text, no footnotes. Agrees with PL-S-001 on the counts.

title: Obec Senné, municipal website: history page headed Súčasnosť
reliability: Written from the village and church chronicles. Detailed and dated for 1848 to 2008. Not footnoted; treat single figures with care.

title: Iňačovce: História and Kultúrne dedičstvo (e-obce.sk, after Vlastivedný slovník, vol. 1)
read: page read in part, search extracts
reliability: Same family as PL-S-001.

title: Iňačovce: Základné údaje (slovensko.sk)
reliability: Official portal, short text, no footnotes.

title: Program hospodárskeho a sociálneho rozvoja obce Iňačovce 2014-2020 (municipal development plan, history chapter)
type: Local history inside a planning document
reliability: Fullest account found for Iňačovce: owners, denominations, resettlement after 1720. Unfootnoted. The later part of the file was not read.

title: Iňačovce (English Wikipedia)
reliability: Used for coordinates and for the list of church registers held at Prešov. The register list is unsourced on the page and matches the Duska and Demko agents' leads.

title: Senné, Michalovce District (English Wikipedia)
reliability: Used for coordinates, area and recent population only.

title: Vavrinec Žeňuch, Obraz Užskej stolice na základe kanonickej vizitácie z roku 1734, Studia Slavica Hungarica 65 (2020) no. 2, pp. 439-454
type: Journal article from a primary source (Eger canonical visitation, 1734)
read: article read through a summarising fetch
reliability: Peer-reviewed, works directly from the 1734 visitation. The strongest source here for parish boundaries and denominations in the 18th century.

title: Vavrinec Žeňuch, Užská stolica z pohľadu súpisu z roku 1733, Studia theologica 28 (2026) no. 1, pp. 137-152
type: Journal article from a primary source (list of churches and parishes, 1733)
read: article read through a summarising fetch
reliability: Peer-reviewed. The 1733 list is a draft made a year before the visitation, so the two differ in detail.

title: Vavrinec Žeňuch, Evolution of the Network of Religious Schools in Ung County in the Eighteenth and Nineteenth Centuries, Annales Universitatis Apulensis Series Historica 26/I (2022), pp. 93-122
read: article read through a summarising fetch
reliability: Peer-reviewed. School lists for 1774, 1864 and 1916 by denomination; states the 1804 transfer from Eger to Szatmár.

title: Hungaricana, urbarial tables: Szenna (Ung)
reliability: Landlord-level summary of the Maria Theresa urbarial survey. Names landlords, not tenants. The page gives no date.

title: Hungaricana, urbarial tables: Solymos (Ung)
reliability: As PL-S-012.

title: Ildikó Zsoldos, Trianon következményei Vécsey László ungszennai uradalmában, Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg county archive yearbook XXII (2021), pp. 313-324
read: article read through a summarising fetch
reliability: Works from the Vécsey family papers in Cluj. About the estate and its owner, not the villagers.

title: Ústav pamäti národa, list of municipalities of Michalovce district (figures from Lexikón obcí Slovenskej republiky, 1942, for 1940)
reliability: State statistics of the wartime Slovak Republic. Proves which villages were inside Slovakia in 1940.

title: Kinship genealogy blog, 1869 Hungarian Census at Transcarpathia Regional Archive, Ukraine (3 Dec 2019)
reliability: First-hand report by a working researcher. Says the Ung county sheets exist at Berehove; gives no fond number and no village list.

title: FamilySearch Community threads on the 1869 census for Ung county
read: search extract; also in the Duska ledger as L-004
reliability: User report that Ung county is absent from the FamilySearch 1869 images. Consistent with PL-S-016.

title: iabsi.com, 1939 annexation of eastern Slovakia
reliability: Compiled map and summary; the author says the line lacks exact precision. Used only for dates.

title: iabsi.com, Slovakia research strategies: churches, and finding post-1895 records
reliability: Cites Law XXXIII of 1894, in force 1 October 1895. Standard and uncontroversial.

title: JewishGen, Slovak civil vital records: introduction
reliability: States the October 1895 start and the 100-year transfer rule from registry office to archive.

title: GCatholic.org, Kostol Návštevy Panny Márie, Senné
reliability: Current directory entry: Roman-rite parish, Archdiocese of Košice, deanery Sobrance.

title: GCatholic.org, Chrám Zosnutia Presvätej Bohorodičky, Iňačovce
reliability: Current directory entry: Byzantine-rite parish, Greek Catholic diocese of Košice.

title: Ung County (English Wikipedia)
reliability: Used for the six districts of the early 20th century, the 1910 totals, and the dates 1920, 1938 and 1945.

title: FamilySearch catalogue 1411329: Greek Catholic records of the Mukachevo eparchy, Ungvár and Ung district, 1826-1938
read: search extract; also in both agents' ledgers
reliability: Catalogue description only. Which villages are inside the series has not been checked.

title: FamilySearch catalogue 710997: Senné (Szenna) Roman Catholic register, 1831-1926
read: not read by this agent; taken from the Duska ledger (L-001)
reliability: Second-hand here. Originals reported at the Prešov state archive.

title: Véghseő, Terdik and others, Források a magyarországi görögkatolikus parókiák történetéhez: a munkácsi egyházmegye parókiarendezési iratai 1782-1787, 4. Ung vármegye (Nyíregyháza, 2017), 624 pp.
read: catalogue record only; the PDF has not been opened
reliability: Parish-by-parish papers of the Greek Catholic reorganisation. Should list Solymos with its daughter villages and head counts. This is the named test for PL-H-001.

title: Košice Region Tourism, Late Renaissance manor house in Senné
reliability: Tourism text. Agrees with PL-S-002 on a 17th-century house.

title: CGSI forum note on the 1930 Czechoslovak census at slovakiana.sk; JewishGen note on the originals
reliability: Says the 1930 sheets for present-day Slovakia are online at slovakiana.sk. JewishGen places the originals in the Slovak National Archives, Bratislava. Coverage by village not checked.

title: Štátny archív v Prešove, finding aid for the fond Užská župa
read: read through a summarising fetch; OCR badly garbled
reliability: Low as read. Appears to be a small fond (11 units, 5 boxes), mostly about Uzhhorod. Nothing for Senné or Iňačovce was seen. Check against the original scan before relying on it.

title: Hungaricana, Urbaria et Conscriptiones: MNL OL E 156 a, fasc. 121, nos. 012 and 014
reliability: No. 012 lists Solymos among Ung county villages described; no. 014 has a valuation that names Szenna with a wooden manor and stables. Dates and contents still to be read.

title: Ledgers of the Duska agent (repo genealogu-duska-1) and the Demko agent (repo genealogy-demko-1), as of 11 Nov 2026
read: read in the project chats; neither repo had been pushed when this page was built
reliability: Hypothesis numbers and wording are quoted from their chats and may have moved on.

title: Greek Catholic Eparchy of Mukachevo (English Wikipedia); Catholic Encyclopedia, Szatmár
reliability: Mukachevo eparchy erected 1771, bishop's seat at Uzhhorod. Szatmár diocese formed out of Eger at the same time as Kassa.

title: Coordinates and base map: GeoNames (via geonamescache 500+), Wikipedia, Natural Earth 1:10m
reliability: Town coordinates from GeoNames or Wikipedia are good to a few hundred metres. Six small villages are placed from memory and marked approximate. Natural Earth has no line for the Uh or the Laborec, so neither river is drawn.

title: Rusyn Society and municipal planning texts on the Little War of March 1939
reliability: Agree that Hungary took the whole Sobrance district (41 villages) and part of Snina district under the protocol of 4 April 1939.
